# Evaluation

<!-- FIXME: I believe this page is desnecessary. Should directly go to the mono2micro paper -->

Each tool below was mapped onto the feature model, and every mapping here is the output of the <a href="{{ '/skills/' | relative_url }}">mapping skills</a> — not a hand-made assessment. The tools are grouped by the paper they were drawn from.


## What each tool page shows

<dl class="provenance"><dt>Automated mapping</dt><dd>What <code>codebase-map</code> or <code>docs-map</code> produced from the tool's own code or documentation, unedited.</dd><dt>Revised mapping</dt><dd>The same mapping after the authors re-checked the cited evidence and corrected it. Both are published so the corrections are visible.</dd><dt>Proposed model extension</dt><dd>Where a tool had a feature the model lacked, that feature was added to a copy of the model. These are the authors' proposals, <b>not</b> skill output, and only three tools produced one.</dd></dl>


## Colour legend

<ul class="legend">
<li><span class="chip chip-dark_green">Group fully mapped</span><span>Every feature in the group was mapped to the tool (feature groups only, never leaves)</span></li>
<li><span class="chip chip-light_green">Mapped</span><span>The feature was mapped to the tool</span></li>
<li><span class="chip chip-yellow">Unmapped (optional)</span><span>The feature was not mapped to the tool, but it is optional</span></li>
<li><span class="chip chip-red">Unmapped (mandatory)</span><span>The feature was not mapped to the tool, although it was mandatory</span></li>
<li><span class="chip chip-orange">Constraint violation</span><span>The feature was not mapped to the tool and this violates a constraint</span></li>
<li><span class="chip chip-magenta">Inconclusive / extra</span><span>The mapping of this feature is inconclusive (automated mapping), or the feature is present in the tool but absent from the model</span></li>
</ul>
